about: Golden conversations for the SI chat (T-13). Each turn is what a visitor types and what the reply must do. Run with: php tests/golden/run.php (dry run, no network) or php tests/golden/run.php --live (real API; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, costs money). Expected quotes are given as price-engine input, so the totals follow the price table.
